# JSZip

`jszip-3.10.1.min.js` is JSZip 3.10.1 (https://github.com/Stuk/jszip), served by this site so the page does not load it from a CDN.

JSZip is dual-licensed under the MIT license or GPLv3. The full text shipped with that version is in `LICENSE.markdown`.

The browser build bundles pako, which is MIT licensed. See `pako-LICENSE` and the copyright comment at the top of `jszip-3.10.1.min.js`.
